library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
x <- LETTERS[1:20]
y <- paste0("var", seq(1,20))
data <- expand.grid(X=x, Y=y)
data$Z <- runif(400, 0, 5)
data$text <- paste0("x: ", data$X, "\ny: ", data$Y, "\nValue: ", round(data$Z, 2))
p <- ggplot(data, aes(X, Y, fill=Z, text=text)) + geom_tile() + theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p, tooltip="text")
